participant_id.Description: Person identifier (as in the source, normalized where noted).

session_id.Description: Scan session identifier within the participant.

site.Description: Acquisition site, as coded by the source.

collection.Description: Source collection (TCIA collection, '<collection>_Additional', or anonymized 'Collection N').

tcia_patient_id.Description: PatientID in the source TCIA collection (for overlap with upenn_gbm / ucsf_pdgm).

study_date.Description: Study date as given in the crosswalk (m/d/yyyy; some cases).

mgmt.Description: MGMT promoter methylation (Task 2 target; also given for some non-Task-2 cases).
